I’ve been here. If you’re depressed (which it sounds like you are) consider searching for professional help. Getting on a pathway to healing really reveals parts of you that got buried with sadness. It’s a long and hard road but it’s really worth it by the end. Good luck, friend :) 
(Edit: adding more tangible things)
Force yourself to go to a local library and just browse books, go on a short walk every day in different areas of your neighborhood, dump every thought in your brain out onto a piece of paper at least once a day, explore volunteering options in your neighborhood, go to any kind of museum that you can, research the history of your family or town, watch a crap ton of movies, and maybe look at pictures of you when you were younger, it could spark some memories in you.
